title: Lớp 11 — Đề Kiểm Tra Giữa Kỳ I · Mã Đề 102 (Đảo Mã Đề Tự Động)

questions.stem_text: Choose the word with a different stress pattern.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: development nhấn âm 2; ba từ còn lại âm 1.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word with a different stress pattern.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: generation nhấn âm 3; các từ còn lại âm 2.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word with a different stress pattern.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: routine nhấn âm 2; các từ khác âm 1.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word with a different stress pattern.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: medicine nhấn âm 1; còn lại nhấn âm cuối.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word with a different stress pattern.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: digital nhấn âm 1; các từ còn lại âm 2.

questions.stem_text: Regular exercise can improve your physical ______.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: strength: sức mạnh thể chất.

questions.stem_text: My mother ______ yoga classes two years ago.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: two years ago: quá khứ đơn.

questions.stem_text: We ______ our grandparents last Sunday.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: last Sunday: quá khứ đơn.

questions.stem_text: My sister ______ healthier meals recently.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: recently: hiện tại hoàn thành phù hợp kết quả gần đây.

questions.stem_text: How long ______ you ______ this fitness tracker?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: How long have you owned: sở hữu kéo dài tới hiện tại.

questions.stem_text: You ______ leave your bike here. The sign says “No parking.”
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: must not = cấm.

questions.stem_text: At this school, everyone ______ follow the safety rules.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: has to: nghĩa vụ theo quy định.

questions.stem_text: You ______ apologise for speaking rudely to your grandmother.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: should nêu lời khuyên phù hợp.

questions.stem_text: Different ______ sometimes lead to arguments between parents and teenagers.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: generations: các thế hệ.

questions.stem_text: My family tries to pass traditional ______ on to younger members.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: pass values on: truyền lại các giá trị.

questions.stem_text: These new apartments look ______.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: look + tính từ comfortable.

questions.stem_text: I ______ what you mean, but I have a different opinion.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: understand chỉ trạng thái nhận thức: simple present.

questions.stem_text: At the moment, our class ______ ideas for a greener school.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: at the moment: đang trao đổi.

questions.stem_text: Cities can reduce air pollution by improving public ______.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: public transport: giao thông công cộng.

questions.stem_text: A ______ is a tall building with many floors.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: skyscraper: nhà chọc trời.

questions.stem_text: I ______ the school health workshop last Thursday.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: last Thursday: quá khứ đơn.

questions.stem_text: My brother ______ for a cycling club since April.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: since April: hiện tại hoàn thành.

questions.stem_text: The council ______ two new green spaces this month.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: this month chưa kết thúc; kết quả tính đến hiện tại.

questions.stem_text: People may feel less stressed when they keep a good work-life ______.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: work-life balance: cân bằng công việc và cuộc sống.

questions.stem_text: The food in the school canteen tastes ______ today.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: taste + tính từ delicious.

questions.stem_text: Teacher: “Why should we walk more often?” Student: “______”
options: Because it is good for our health.
written_answers: Because it is good for our health.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: Why -> lý do.

questions.stem_text: Huy: “My parents and I disagree about my bedtime.” Mai: “______”
options: You could explain your reasons politely.
written_answers: You could explain your reasons politely.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: Phản hồi khuyên trao đổi lịch sự.

questions.stem_text: Lan: “I have just finished my health project.” Nam: “______”
options: Well done! What did you learn?
written_answers: Well done! What did you learn?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: Chúc mừng và hỏi thêm là đáp lời tự nhiên.

questions.stem_text: SIGN: “CYCLISTS MUST WEAR HELMETS.” What does it tell cyclists?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: must wear: phải đội mũ bảo hiểm.

questions.stem_text: SIGN: “NO ENTRY – STAFF ONLY.” Who may enter?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: staff only: chỉ nhân viên được phép.

questions.stem_text: SIGN: “PLEASE SWITCH OFF LIGHTS WHEN LEAVING.” What should people do?
options: Turn off the lights before leaving.
written_answers: Turn off the lights before leaving.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: switch off: tắt.

questions.stem_text: NOTICE: “The youth debate starts at 9 a.m. Registration closes at 8:45 a.m.” When must participants register?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: Trước hoặc đúng 8:45.

questions.stem_text: NOTICE: “The smart-library app is under maintenance tonight. You can borrow books at the counter.” What is still possible?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: Có thể mượn sách ở quầy.

questions.stem_text: NOTICE: “Free city tour on Saturday. Meet at the museum entrance, not the bus station.” Where should visitors meet?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: Điểm tập trung là cửa bảo tàng.

questions.stem_text: NOTICE: “The fitness class will be held online if heavy rain continues tomorrow.” What does this mean?
options: The class was cancelled last week.
The class is only for teachers.
The class may move online depending on the weather.
written_answers: The class may move online depending on the weather.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: if: phụ thuộc vào thời tiết.

questions.stem_text: What did Minh find difficult at his new school?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: Cậu khó giao tiếp với bạn cùng lớp.

questions.stem_text: What did Minh’s teacher suggest?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: Thầy cô gợi ý đội tình nguyện trồng cây.

questions.stem_text: Which statement about Minh is TRUE before he joined the team?
options: He had never done such an activity before.
He had already led many teams.
He knew everyone in the team.
written_answers: He had never done such an activity before.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: He had never taken part ... before.

questions.stem_text: What has Minh continued to do?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: has continued volunteering.

questions.stem_text: What can we infer from Minh’s experience?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: Tham gia hoạt động giúp cậu tự tin hơn.

questions.stem_text: What is Riverton planning?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: pedestrian-friendly neighbourhood.

questions.stem_text: Which service will help people who cannot walk far?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: small electric shuttle.

questions.stem_text: Where can residents read the proposal?
options: At a clinic or a gym.
Online or at the local library.
written_answers: Online or at the local library.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: online or at the local library.

questions.stem_text: Why are some shop owners worried?
options: The shuttle will be too fast.
Fewer parking places may affect their businesses.
The streets will have no trees.
written_answers: Fewer parking places may affect their businesses.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: Lượng chỗ đỗ xe giảm có thể ảnh hưởng kinh doanh.

questions.stem_text: Which statement is TRUE according to the passage?
options: Shop owners will not be consulted.
The plan has already been approved.
The final decision will follow community consultation.
written_answers: The final decision will follow community consultation.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: Quyết định sau tham vấn cộng đồng.

questions.stem_text: Which sentence correctly expresses prohibition?
options: You should enter this restricted area.
You don't have to enter this restricted area.
You must not enter this restricted area.
You need not enter this restricted area.
written_answers: You must not enter this restricted area.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: must not: cấm, không phải không cần.

questions.stem_text: Choose the grammatically correct sentence.
options: This device is belonging to my father.
I am believing smart cities will help us.
My brother is having a meeting with city planners now.
The building seems safely at night.
written_answers: My brother is having a meeting with city planners now.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: have a meeting chỉ hoạt động nên dùng tiếp diễn được.

questions.stem_text: Which sentence has the same meaning as “He started using the app in May and still uses it”?
options: He is used the app since May.
He has used the app in May.
He used the app since May.
He has used the app since May.
written_answers: He has used the app since May.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: has used ... since May.

questions.stem_text: Choose the most appropriate advice. “My grandfather finds the new bus app confusing.”
options: Tell him that his opinions do not matter.
Ignore him because he is older.
Show him how to use it and keep a printed timetable available.
written_answers: Show him how to use it and keep a printed timetable available.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: Hỗ trợ khả năng dùng công nghệ, giữ lựa chọn thay thế.

questions.stem_text: Choose the sentence in which the linking verb is followed correctly.
options: The river water smells strangely today.
The green transport plan sounds reasonable.
written_answers: The green transport plan sounds reasonable.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: sound + tính từ reasonable.
